verdict.rationale: Remote-access and screen-control tools can plausibly offer scoped API tokens for agents, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API and no credential issuance of any kind: Sill has no account or server, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI all return 404. Per-device pairing and removal is an adjacent device-trust control, not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
